purpose: Neutral vocabulary only. This catalog is not evidence, training data, examples, scores, or an occupational prior.
evidencePolicy: Use only the supplied Outlook item from the authorized mailbox as evidence.
Never transfer assumptions or scores from these definitions to an employee.
Never infer activity from occupation, identity, writing style, volume, participants, or duration alone.

decisionPolicy.undecidedWhen: The item lacks a concrete action, decision, outcome, problem, assistance, communication purpose, mentoring behavior, or created alternative.

decidedScoring.0: Enough detail to decide, with no observable signal for the dimension.
decidedScoring.50-74: Explicit, meaningful evidence central to part of the item.
decidedScoring.75-89: Strong, central evidence with a concrete outcome or decision.

rolePolicy.purpose: Standard functional-role naming only; titles are not evidence or priors.
rolePolicy.decidedWhen: The Outlook item contains an explicit role title attributable to the mailbox owner or multiple concrete responsibilities that distinguish a functional role.
rolePolicy.undecidedWhen: The available evidence is generic, shared by many roles, or depends on identity, participants, writing style, seniority, activity volume, or assumptions.

elements: Establishing long-range objectives and specifying the strategies and actions to achieve them.
Analyzing information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand their points, and asking questions as appropriate.
Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.
Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others
Translating or explaining what information means and how it can be used.
Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others
Handling complaints, settling disputes, resolving grievances and conflicts, or negotiating with others.
Identifying developmental needs and coaching, mentoring, or helping others improve their knowledge or skills.
Providing guidance and direction, including setting standards and monitoring performance.
Teaching others how to do something.
Developing, designing, or creating new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products.
Developing unusual or clever ideas or creative ways to solve a problem.
Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop, evaluate, and implement solutions.
Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about them.
Actively looking for ways to help people.
Providing assistance, emotional support, or other care to coworkers, customers, or patients.
